description: Announced/reported/rumoured changes 2026-2030. Announcements are not availability evidence, so they are not exported as records.

outlook.announcement: Successor to the EQE will be an electric E-Class, brought forward to H2 2027 (originally 2028), built on the smaller MB.EA-M architecture
customer_facing_changes: Electric version of the core E-Class nameplate instead of a separate EQE
Classic three-box 'status-oriented business sedan' design, likely about 5 m long (slightly elongated)
Built on MB.EA-M (MB.EA-L not ready)
Current EQE reportedly to get a 2026 update incl. 800 V technology
EQE US production reportedly paused indefinitely from 1 Sep 2025
outlook.notes: electrive relays the blog JESMB, which refers to a CEO Ola Källenius announcement; no direct Mercedes release fetched. No fetched source covers MB.OS arriving in the E-Class or a W214 facelift; Autocar (EQE end of production in 2026) and Motor Authority were blocked (402/403).

outlook.announcement: Model year 2027 tech refresh for A6 e-tron and Q6 e-tron (announced Feb 2026)
customer_facing_changes: Physical buttons return on the steering wheel; a scroll wheel replaces touch-sensitive controls for volume and menus
Refreshed MMI interface with updated graphics, fewer long lists
Updated voice-control capabilities
'Power Nap' mode for relaxing while charging
Available high-resolution 4K dashcam
outlook.notes: KBB report of Audi's announcement. Audi reverses touch-only controls; relevant against the G60's touch-based climate and controls.

outlook.announcement: China-specific long-wheelbase A6L e-tron on pre-sale from late March 2026, four variants, 313,000-443,000 CNY pre-sale prices
customer_facing_changes: Long wheelbase 3,076 mm (direct answer to 5 Series Li / i5 Li)
107 kWh battery, up to 815 km range (cycle not named)
800 V architecture, 270 kW max charging, 302 km added in 10 min
Huawei Qiankun ADS: urban point-to-point NOA and complex-scenario parking
AR head-up display
outlook.notes: OEM pre-sale reported by CnEVPost. A German premium rival adopting Huawei ADS in China raises the bar for G68 ADAS (G68: L2, no NOA listed).

outlook.announcement: Production of Model S and Model X ended at Fremont (Tesla post, 10 May 2026); line repurposed for Optimus humanoid robots
customer_facing_changes: No new Model S built after May 2026; no successor announced
Tesla's large-sedan presence shrinks to Model 3 / Model Y in the volume segment
Fremont S/X line converted to Optimus production
outlook.notes: Plan first announced by Elon Musk on the Q4 2025 earnings call (Fox Business, 28 Jan 2026: https://www-ak-ms.foxbusiness.com/fox-news-auto/tesla-ends-production-model-s-model-x-vehicles-focus-robots-2026). Service/update support for existing owners not covered by the sources. Implication: the 5 Series successor is unlikely to face a Tesla large sedan.

outlook.announcement: FSD (Supervised) approved country by country in Europe: Netherlands provisional approval early April 2026, Slovenia sixth European country (Sept 2026); EU-wide vote possibly from Oct 2026
customer_facing_changes: Point-to-point supervised assisted driving (L2) on European roads in a growing set of countries
Driver must still pay attention
Potential EU-wide availability if the EU vote passes
outlook.notes: Reuters via The Star. FSD is a software package across Tesla models, not Model 3-specific. Search snippets say the EU vote was deferred to December 2026; not verified by fetch. Compare G60 EU: hands-off only on German Autobahn up to 130 km/h (E0008).

outlook.announcement: Next-generation G80 reportedly delayed across all powertrains; next G80 EV not expected before 2029; possible EREV G80 near end of decade
customer_facing_changes: Current gas and hybrid G80 continue until about the end of the decade
No new G80 EV before 2029 (Electrified G80 dropped in North America; still sold in Europe as of 2025)
Possible range-extender (EREV) G80 later
outlook.notes: Based on Korean blogger Motorsjason (also TheKoreanCarBlog), relayed by Electrek; Genesis did not confirm. Implication: an ageing G80 when the 5 Series successor arrives.

outlook.announcement: All-new ES with hybrid (ES 300h/350h) and first battery-electric versions (ES 350e/500e); phased regional rollout from mid-2026
customer_facing_changes: First BEV ES: CLTC target approx. 685 km (350e) / 610 km (500e) on 19" tyres
150 kW DC, 10-80 % in approx. 30 min at 25 °C
Larger body: length 5,140 mm (+165), wheelbase 2,950 mm (+80)
'Responsive Hidden Switches' blending physical controls into the interior
'Sensory Concierge' syncing lighting, climate and fragrance; panoramic roof with dimming (prototype)
outlook.notes: Official Toyota/Lexus newsroom. Already on sale in some markets by Oct 2026; the BEV charging (150 kW, ~30 min) is no better than the i5. Screen size, Arene software and US EPA figures appear in search snippets but were not verified by fetch (Lexus Australia page returned 403).

outlook.announcement: Google Gemini replaces Google Assistant via OTA on 16 Volvo models incl. ES90, starting 30 Apr 2026 in the US, other markets following
customer_facing_changes: Conversational LLM assistant (Gemini) instead of canned voice commands
Trip planning and music via natural prompts (e.g. find a stop that sells croissants on the route)
Delivered over the air to existing cars back to 2020
Requires an online car and, at launch, a US English Google account
outlook.notes: Hardware context (KBB, Feb 2025: https://www.kbb.com/car-news/2026-volvo-es90-the-classic-volvo-luxury-sedan-electrified): dual NVIDIA DRIVE AGX Orin, one lidar, five radars, eight cameras, continuous OTA updates. ES90 US availability unclear (search snippet: Consumer Reports says no current US plans; not verified). Google built-in is not offered on Chinese-market Volvos, so CN not tagged.

outlook.announcement: Next-gen SU7 launched 19 Mar 2026 at 219,900 / 249,900 / 303,900 CNY (Standard / Pro / Max); over 15,000 locked orders in 34 minutes
customer_facing_changes: Lidar and Nvidia Thor (700 TOPS) standard on all versions
Assisted driving powered by Xiaomi's 'XLA' cognitive large language model
CLTC range 720 km (Standard, 73 kWh); 902 km (Pro, 96.3 kWh); 835 km (Max, 101.7 kWh)
Silicon-carbide high-voltage platform; Max adds 670 km in 15 min
Wheelbase 3,000 mm
outlook.notes: OEM launch reported by CnEVPost. A larger 'SU7 L' executive sedan (>5.2 m, >3.1 m wheelbase) appears only in search snippets citing Sina Tech; not verified, so no record.

outlook.announcement: Xiaomi will only consider selling cars outside China from 2027 (CEO Lei Jun, Jul 2025)
customer_facing_changes: Possible arrival of Xiaomi EVs in export markets from 2027
Domestic market has priority until then because of strong SU7/YU7 orders
outlook.notes: Reuters via Aletihad. The page does not name Europe or specific models; search snippets (not fetched) say Xiaomi later named Europe as first destination with sales from Q3/Q4 2027.

outlook.announcement: Updated 007 and 007 GT on pre-sale from 2 Apr 2026, launch 10 Apr 2026
customer_facing_changes: Upgrade from 800 V to 900 V architecture
6C charging: 10-80 % in about 10 min
Range up to 905 km (cycle not named); 75 and 103 kWh packs
Nvidia Drive Thor-U assisted-driving chip
Up to 370 kW single-motor; 0-100 km/h in 2.73 s (dual motor)
outlook.notes: OEM pre-sale reported by CnEVPost; updated-model prices not stated (current 007 from 209,900 CNY). 10-80 % in ~10 min vs i5 205 kW / 30 min (EU) and 30-80 % in 0.6 h (CN i5 Li).

outlook.announcement: Updated Luxeed S7 on sale from 23 Mar 2026, from 239,800 CNY (+10,000 CNY), seven months after the previous update
customer_facing_changes: 896-channel image-grade lidar standard on all trims
Huawei Qiankun ADS 4 assisted driving
New exterior colours
Fast update cadence (two updates within about seven months)
outlook.notes: Luxeed S7 is the HIMA sedan closest to the 5 Series Li price band. Range/charging and HarmonyOS version not stated on the page.

outlook.announcement: Updated Maextro S800 (and AITO M9) to get Huawei's highest line-count mass-produced lidar (500-line per MIIT filing) and the upcoming Qiankun ADS 5.0; details at HIMA tech launch on 4 Mar 2026
customer_facing_changes: 500-line lidar (reportedly upgradeable to 1,000 lines)
Qiankun ADS 5.0 expected (current car: ADS 4.0 with 192-line lidar + 3 solid-state lidars)
S800 was China's best-selling luxury saloon as of Jan 2026
outlook.notes: Lidar spec from MIIT filing; ADS 5.0 'expected'. S800 is a 7 Series / S-Class-level rival but sets the HIMA technology ceiling. Inconsistency: Luxeed S7 (O012) is reported with an 896-channel lidar, while the S800's 500-line unit is called the world's highest line-count; channel vs line counting likely differs.

outlook.announcement: Huawei targets large-scale L3 highway deployment in 2026 and large-scale L3 adoption in 2027, plus L4 urban pilots, subject to regulatory approval (Jin Yuzhi, WNEVC, Sept 2025)
customer_facing_changes: Highway L3 (eyes-off under conditions) on Huawei-equipped cars from 2026 where approved
L3 at scale from 2027; L4 urban pilots from 2026
Qiankun ADS already in over one million vehicles across 28 models
outlook.notes: Statement by the CEO of Huawei's Smart Car Solutions BU, reported by CarNewsChina. Huawei ADS also supplies Audi's A6L e-tron in China (O003). Search snippets mention HIMA L3 internal testing in Shenzhen (AITO M9, Maextro S800); not verified by fetch.

outlook.model: Neue Klasse technologies (iX3) - context for 5 Series
outlook.announcement: Neue Klasse technologies shown at CES 2026; to be integrated into 40 new models and model updates by 2027 and to shape the whole range
customer_facing_changes: BMW Intelligent Personal Assistant extended with Amazon Alexa+ (LLM) from H2 2026 at the latest in Germany and the USA, on OS 9 and OS X
BMW Panoramic iDrive: mix of digital functions and physical elements
Gen6 eDrive: 800 V, up to 400 kW DC, 10-80 % in 21 min; iX3 50 xDrive up to 805 km WLTP
Highway Assistant hands-free up to 130 km/h (85 mph) with automated lane changes; Highway and City Assistant stops and restarts at traffic lights (country-dependent)
BMW Operating System X with app/entertainment ecosystem
outlook.notes: Context only (BMW's own direction). Gap vs current G60: i5 205 kW / 30 min vs NK 400 kW / 21 min; G60 runs OS 8.5 per DE list, so the Alexa+ scope (OS 9 / OS X) does not obviously include today's G60 outside China (Xinhua calls the CN 5 Series LWB system 'ninth generation').

outlook.model: 5 Series (G60 LCI) and Neue Klasse 5 Series (NC0)
outlook.announcement: G60 LCI expected July 2027; Neue Klasse 5 Series 'NC0' expected July 2030 on the full NK platform
customer_facing_changes: LCI: Panoramic Vision windshield display (as in 7 Series LCI)
LCI: optional passenger display
LCI: chassis control suspension replaces current adaptive options
LCI: tiered highway and city drive assists as options for the first time
NC0: full NK platform with 800 V charging and native Panoramic iDrive X
outlook.notes: Enthusiast-site analysis; no BMW confirmation or named source. Context only. The LCI is the version that will actually meet most of the 2027-2030 competitor moves listed here.

outlook.announcement: MIIT approved the first two L3 production models on 15 Dec 2025 (Deepal SL03, Arcfox Alpha S); both got dedicated L3 licence plates; analysts expect more approvals in 2026
customer_facing_changes: L3 on single lanes of selected highways/urban expressways: Deepal up to 50 km/h in congestion (Chongqing), Arcfox up to 80 km/h (Beijing)
System is force-disabled outside approved roads; driver must stay seated and ready to take over
Counterpoint expects approvals for BYD, FAW, GAC, NIO, SAIC and L3 launches by Xpeng, Tesla and Huawei partners in H2 2026
outlook.notes: Regulatory approval is official (MIIT); the outlook part (further approvals) is analyst forecast. Search snippet (not fetched) mentions a mandatory national L3/L4 standard effective July 2027. The G68 i5 lists L2 driver assistance only (E0050).

outlook.announcement: Generative-AI assistants arriving via OTA: Volvo/Google Gemini on 16 models from 30 Apr 2026; Mercedes layered ChatGPT on MBUX; Stellantis ChatGPT in some Chrysler models; BMW builds its own assistant
customer_facing_changes: Natural, intent-based conversation instead of fixed voice commands
Prompt-based trip planning and media control
Retrofitted to existing cars over the air (Volvo back to 2020 model years)
outlook.notes: China equivalent: BMW China announced DeepSeek for the 5 Series LWB / i5 from Q3 2025 (Xinhua, E0046); BMW Alexa+ from H2 2026 in DE/US (O015). By the 5 Series successor an LLM assistant will be table stakes in all three markets.

outlook.announcement: BYD Super e-Platform (Mar 2025): 1,000 V, up to 1,000 kW charging, 10C batteries; Han L / Tang L launched Apr 2025 from 270,000 CNY; 4,000+ megawatt flash chargers planned
customer_facing_changes: About 400 km (CLTC) added in 5 minutes (Han L), 370 km (Tang L)
Dedicated megawatt charger network with stationary storage where needed
Sets a reference that 10-80 % in about 10-15 min (Zeekr 007 6C, Xiaomi SU7 Max) is the new Chinese norm
outlook.notes: electrive notes reported charger power is inconsistent (1,000 vs 1,360 kW) and that peak power is short-lived. CN i5 Li: 30-80 % in 0.6 h; NK Gen6: 10-80 % in 21 min (O015).

outlook.announcement: Comprehensive facelift of the combustion/PHEV E-Class reported for 2027, launching alongside the new electric (seventh-generation) E-Class.
customer_facing_changes: Exterior design adopts the design language of the new electric E-Class
Combustion and PHEV versions continue in sedan and estate form on the MRA II platform

outlook.announcement: Seventh-generation electric E-Class reported to debut in 2027 and replace the EQE sedan.
customer_facing_changes: Traditional three-box sedan silhouette with a long, status-oriented wheelbase instead of the EQE's one-bow shape (reported)
MB.EA platform shared with the GLC EQ and electric C-Class (reported)
800 V architecture with up to 350 kW DC charging (expected)
Single-motor RWD and dual-motor AWD versions, adaptive air suspension and rear-wheel steering (expected)
EQ naming dropped and EVs styled like combustion models (Mercedes statement)
